reviews.text: Excellent service. My dog ​​feels very calm here. The veterinarians are very friendly and highly trained. They are clear and reassuring.
Samathas and Vero are the best!

I would like to thank each and every person who was with us during the last days of our beloved Wanda, for their empathy, affection, and professionalism.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart to Carolina, Laura, Mar, and Marc, as well as to all the assistants and administrative staff at Hospital Veterinari Balmes.
Thank you very much for your rating, Marisa, and for trusting Hospital Veterinarian Balmes! We are happy to know that your experience has been positive. A hug from the whole team! 🐾 …
Exceptional treatment from all the staff. My cat Rayo spent one night in the hospital and received outstanding care. They were very kind in answering our questions after his discharge. Thank you all.

A wonderful clinic. Our dog Bala recently passed away, and we went there for an emergency visit at night. They were fantastic—the veterinarians, receptionists, and assistants all tried their best. We received very compassionate treatment. Now we've decided to bring our newest family member, Xispa, and it's been great. We enjoyed our first visit; they are knowledgeable and friendly. Congratulations, keep up the good work!
I'm very happy with the professionals at the center. Special mention to Carolina, who took care of my dog, and to Mónica, who sorted out the paperwork with the billing. Thank you so much!

10 out of 10! They are incredibly warm and kind.
I must highlight how attentive they are to every animal that comes in; they look for and provide the best care and solution for everything.
I love that my kittens are so calm when they come because they are treated with such gentleness and love ✨🫶🏻 Vivienne and Westwood will definitely come here whenever they can to be cared for 💕💕
Very caring and professional treatment from the entire team at the center.

I came with my cat from another hospital in Cornellà (Roc Verd: awful in every way) and I felt well cared for: with a clear and concise diagnosis and treatment options, plus a pleasant and professional approach. Thank you
Samanta was incredibly kind when she greeted our dog and me. Victor is also a true professional and always explains everything very clearly to me regarding my dog's condition. Thank you all!

I want to express my deepest gratitude for the care we received at the Balmes Veterinary Clinic, especially from the veterinary oncology specialist, Nuria Bermúdez, and her technician, Alba.

From the very first moment, they treated Simba with a warmth, affection, and gentleness that I will never forget. They were very empathetic with us, but also clear and direct in explaining the situation, even when they had to deliver such difficult news. We were there for more than four hours, and they performed all the necessary tests to understand what was happening to him and so that we could leave with the peace of mind that they had done everything possible.

I will always cherish the way they treated Simba. In Nuria and Alba's eyes, I could see that they are truly dedicated professionals, that they also suffer, and that they do everything in their power to help those of us who arrive there with a member of our family, even though some people still simply call them pets.

Although ultimately nothing could be done to cure Simba, thanks to their sincerity and guidance, we were able to be there for him, support him, and spare him any suffering, just as we had intended from the beginning.

Every time I pass by the clinic while working nights, I will remember Nuria and Alba and the wonderful care they gave us during one of the most difficult times of our lives.

Thank you so much. I want you to know that what you do, and especially the way you do it, has an enormous impact and immeasurable value for families. That kindness is unforgettable, and I am sure that one day I will be able to repay you for what you have done for us.

I am including some photos of Simba as a memento, one from a year ago and another from two days before he passed away.

THANK YOU
Thank you for saving Foc's life and taking such good care of him (and me!). You are very good professionals and good people.
Thank you very much for your 5-star rating, Marc. We are happy to know that you had a good experience at the Balmes Veterinary Hospital. The entire team thanks you for your trust. Best regards!

Thank you so much for sharing your feedback, Ludmila, and for your trust in our team. It is very important to us to support our patients and their families with care and attention, especially during difficult times. We remain at your service for anything you may need. Warm regards from the entire team.

Experience of 10! It was not an easy situation, our cat arrived with very serious kidney involvement, they provided us with objective analytical data, prognosis and options in less than 6 hours. Everything was facilitated to visit our companion when he was admitted. As soon as the situation became irreversible, they notified us and the farewell was very calm and accompanied. The humane treatment by all the staff is exceptional, from reception to ICU through the entire team of veterinarians and assistants.

Excellent care! My dog ​​has always received wonderful treatment here. Her surgery and other ailments were handled very well. Without a doubt, this is my go-to place for my pet's care. Unfortunately, we had to move to another city, but we will always remember them as the best veterinary hospital we've ever taken Saya to. Thank you to all the doctors and staff who always treated us so well, especially Doctors Miquel, Noelia, Ferran, Víctor, Marina, Nuria, and all the wonderful staff who work at this institution. Thank you so much!

Best vet I’ve had in my life. First surgery in 10 years that my dog hasn’t ripped up the stitches and turned it into a 3mo process. Otherwise, always incredibly attentive, thorough, and kind. Highly recommend.
Thank you very much for your review! We are happy to know that your experience with us has been positive. We will continue to work to offer you the best possible service.
Thank you very much for the 5 stars! We are very happy to have your trust. Greetings from the entire team at the Balmes Veterinary Hospital!
Thank you very much for your rating, Laura! We are very happy to know that you are happy with us. Thank you for trusting the team at the Balmes Veterinary Hospital!
Thank you very much for the 5 stars, Niki! We are very happy to receive your rating and to know that you trust us. A hug from the entire team at the Balmes Veterinary Hospital!

dr Monica and marina are the sweetest the rest of reception is rude and needs
To be replaced

We took our kitten Leia, who was very sick, and she stayed for 10 days. They saved her life. The team of professionals are incredibly kind; the reception staff always check in on us and show genuine concern. Laura, an amazing veterinarian and a wonderful person, treated us exceptionally well. She was very attentive and provided excellent care throughout our stay. Thank you all so much!
Very good; everything went as they said. Cleaning the dog's teeth
Professional and friendly service, and very attentive to my dog's needs.
Very professional!!! And attentive!!!

Our experience at this veterinary hospital was, frankly, very disappointing and left us with the feeling that it was more about making money than providing care that inspired confidence.

We went there as an emergency because our dog had an intestinal problem, with vomiting, and naturally, when you see your pet unwell, you worry and want them seen as soon as possible. We fully understand that an emergency has a higher cost and accepted that we had to pay for the care received.

What didn't seem normal to us was the number of tests, medications, and antibiotics they administered for a problem that, as we later discovered, seemed much simpler than we were initially led to believe. At the time, we paid for everything because when you have your pet there and they explain different possibilities and problems, you trust the professionals and do what you think is necessary.

The next day, as instructed, we brought a stool sample for testing. Of course, we were also charged for that.

What has bothered us most, however, has been the lack of follow-up information. Several months have passed since then, and we've called a few times to find out the results of that test and what our dog might have. We haven't received a clear answer, nor have we been properly informed of the results, to the point that we don't even know for sure if the test was ever performed or what the conclusion was.

And that's what has definitively caused us to lose all confidence.

We understand that emergency veterinary care can be expensive and that there are situations where different tests are necessary. What we don't understand is paying significant amounts and then not receiving any follow-up or clear information about the tests performed.

We left with the feeling that the experience was very expensive and lacked transparency, and frankly, we won't be taking our dog to this clinic again.

It's a shame, because when you take your pet in a moment of concern, the least you expect is professionalism, transparency, and trust.
Excellent, serious and professional

I went there for an emergency with my dog ​​and they attended to him immediately!
An exceptional place! Excellent service and excellent professionals! I recommend it 100%!!!

Thank you very much for taking a moment to share your review. We are happy to hear that your experience at Hospital Veterinari Balmes has been positive.

We will continue to work to provide the best possible care to our patients and their families.

Greetings from the entire team!

My dog ​​had surgery on her cruciate ligament in her knee, and she didn't want to leave the vet's office. They took excellent care of her. They explained everything perfectly to us, and were very attentive and kind.

Five stars simply aren't enough to describe the care we received all these years.

After ten years of coming through the doors of this hospital, my Kitty has passed away 💔. And although I am devastated by her loss, I also feel immense gratitude towards everyone who cared for her for so many years. At a time like this, it's hard to find anything positive amidst so much sadness, but knowing that she was surrounded by professionals who did everything possible for her throughout her life is something I will always carry with me.

These have been ten years of visits, illnesses, scares, hospitalizations, and very difficult moments, but also ten years knowing that Kitty was in the best hands. She was never just another patient. You always treated her with incredible love and dedication.

I want to thank Mónica, Nuria, Ruth, Tatiana, Marc, Mar, Ferran, and so many others whose names I'm sure I'm forgetting. Thank you for every gesture, every explanation, every call, and above all, for the love with which you always treated my little one.

And especially, thank you to Dr. Miquel. Thanks to him, my baby has been able to live almost 15 years despite all the illnesses she had to face. It's difficult to explain what it means to thank someone for years of life for someone you love so much.

Miquel is an incredible doctor, but there's a huge difference between practicing a profession and truly feeling what you've decided to dedicate your life to. And it shows. He has immense dedication. He's patient, approachable, kind, and able to explain reality objectively without ever losing his sensitivity. I've rarely encountered professionals like him, even compared to human medicine.

When you love an animal so much, putting its life in someone else's hands is one of the greatest acts of trust there is. For ten years, we never doubted where we wanted Kitty to be.

Don't hesitate to bring your animals here. I wish everyone could feel the peace of mind that comes from knowing someone is caring for what they love most with the same care they would give it themselves.

Thank you for taking care of my princess for so many years, for being there for her through so many stages of her life, and for doing everything possible to help her get to where she is today.

We also owe a part of her almost 15 years to you, and that's something we will never forget.

We will be forever grateful.

With much love:
Kitty, Susana, Sara, and Bimbo ❤️‍🩹

I've been taking my pets here for years and I'm so happy with the care, compassion, and professionalism they receive. Dr. Josep M. Tusell recently operated on my greyhound, Niebla, to remove a carcinoma. She's doing perfectly.
And my cat, Roxy, had an infected tooth extracted; she's doing perfectly too.
Many thanks to the entire team, including the reception staff.

Thank you so much for sharing your 5-star review, Ilonka. It's very important for the entire team at Hospital Veterinari Balmes to know that those who trust us have a positive experience. Thank you for your trust, and best regards from the whole team!

They treated me wonderfully, it's centrally located, and they have excellent facilities (much larger than they might appear from the outside). Furthermore, even though I was with my dog ​​who wasn't terribly urgent or life-threatening, they helped me as much as they could, which is incredibly appreciated at that moment when your pet has something you don't know the cause of.
It's hard to find a vet where you feel comfortable and safe, but Hospital Balmes is our safe space. They have always treated our dog Nira excellently, both in visits and admissions and operations.
Excellent emergency service, fast and efficient!

While my husband and I were out of the country, our beloved cat Lincoln suddenly became critically ill and had to be hospitalized here for several days. Being thousands of miles away while your baby is fighting for his life is an incredibly helpless feeling, and we will always be grateful for the care, kindness and compassion we received during that crisis.

The team worked tirelessly to help our poor boy, while coordinating wonderfully with our pet sitter and keeping us constantly informed from afar. They communicated with us, answered our questions, explained what was happening and did everything they could to give Lincoln a chance to come home to us.

Unfortunately, despite everyone's efforts, we ultimately lost our sweet boy. But we will always know that he was cared for and that everything possible was done to try to save him.

When we finally made it back to Barcelona, the team was just as compassionate with us as they had been with Lincoln. They gave us the time and space we needed with him and helped us through an impossibly difficult moment with genuine kindness and empathy.

There is something incredibly meaningful about knowing that when we couldn't physically be there for Lincoln, he was surrounded by people who were fighting for him and treating him with care.

We will forever be grateful for everything you did for our boy and for us. Thank you for taking such good care of Lincoln when we couldn't be there ourselves. 🤍
